name: app-violet-travel-ui-kit-43-screens-overview
title: Violet Travel UI Kit Overview
whatItIs: A tall pale sheet titled '43 Editable Screens' with tag chips (Booking, Hotel, Flight...) above a grid of flat violet-and-white app screens: splash, onboarding, login, home, hotel booking, lists, filters, reviews, checkout, seat select and tickets.
whatItMeans: A dense grid with an obvious count sells completeness, and a single violet keeps the kit unified.
techniques: Headline states the quantity of content
Uniform grid of full screens with consistent headers
Violet header blocks with white content cards
Fade at the bottom with an 'and more' pill
bestFor: Showing an entire app flow at a glance

Chips listing the topics a kit includes.
A gradual fade at the end hinting at more content.
